Route: Direct
Referral details: Providers in Ottawa. Ottawa Abortion Clinic, 65 Bank St 3rd floor, 613-567-8300 — surgical abortion approx. 5 to 19.6 weeks (suction/D&C first trimester, D&E second) plus medication abortion with Mifegymiso; no referral needed, self-referral by phone. Choices Ottawa, 1355 Bank St Suite 205 (613-721-2907) and Barrhaven (343-644-9877 opt 4) — medication abortion with Mifegymiso to 10 weeks, no cost with OHIP, RAMQ, NIHB, IFHP or CFHS. Origyns Medical Clinic — medication abortion. Clinique des femmes de l'Outaouais, Gatineau — surgical and medication abortion, an option for francophone patients and those west of the river. Options counselling and provider information: Planned Parenthood Ottawa Options Line 613-226-3234 ext. 101, Mon–Fri 12–4pm, ppottawa@ppottawa.ca — does not perform abortions; gives provider contacts by phone only, deliberately not published online. Action Canada Access Line 1-888-642-2725 — 24/7, arranges access and funding. Any prescriber may provide medical abortion — no special licensing required. NOTE for referrers: First Place Options and Birthright of Ottawa both state on their own sites that they do not perform or refer for abortion (First Place: 'We do not perform abortions or make referrals for an abortion'; Birthright: 'not a medical facility, therefore we are unable to provide or refer for medical services'). Miriam Centre's site mentions abortion only in the context of post-loss grief support and does not state whether it provides or refers. Check the Resources tab for each organisation's own wording.
